caption: The drawing depicts five objects arranged on a plain, light-colored background with subtle shading. Two of the objects are cylindrical, handled stamps with flat, circular ends, each end engraved with a distinct pattern; one stamp is shown upright, the other lying flat so that the circular design, which appears to have a grid or lattice motif, is visible. There is a separate, shorter cylindrical object standing vertically in the center, which appears undecorated, with some vertical grooves for texture. Another object resembles a cone or blunt peg, laying on its side, and its flat end bears a design consisting of intersecting lines and symbols. The final object is a large, bowl-shaped vessel lying on its side, revealing its circular interior, which is decorated with a leaf-like or fern pattern. All objects are rendered in shades of brown and beige, with the details and engravings carefully highlighted through tonal variation. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to create texture and dimensionality across the wooden or carved surfaces.
title: Butter Print and Mold
